subject: Request for service reprieve following Nov 28 downtime
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@meridianhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, Nov 28 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production outage Nov 28 — request for compensation

Hi Laura,

We experienced a ~45 minute outage in our production environment yesterday morning (Nov 28) that caused downstream job failures for batch processing and delayed several customer-facing reports. Our SREs traced the window to requests routed to a degraded cluster and sustained 99.5% P99s for ~30 minutes. Can you confirm what happened on your side and what remedy or compensation Redwood can provide? Our procurement team will need something formal they can accept.

We rely on your API for critical reporting; the outage caused a measurable SLA miss with our payors. I can share logs and timestamps (attached) if helpful.

Thanks —
Sara
Head of Platform Operations
Meridian Health

Attachments: meridian-incident-log-20261128.csv

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Sat, Nov 28 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production outage Nov 28 — request for compensation

Sara —

I'm really sorry for the disruption. Thank you for sending the logs; our on-call ran a preliminary review and we saw he had an autoscaling hiccup combined with a model fallback loop that amplified latency for a short window.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I've escalated to our incident review team and asked for a full RCA (target EOD Mon).
- I'll propose a provisional remediation and a compensation package for your procurement team to consider.

Proposed short-term remediation: a one-time credit equivalent to two weeks of average consumption for your account, plus a complimentary two-week extension of your Sandbox trial for the integration team to validate fallback behavior (we'll whitelist your tenant for rolling hotfixes). I want to confirm with my finance/legal colleagues before sending firm language.

I'll follow up early next week with the RCA and a formal credit proposal. Apologies again — we understand how disruptive this is.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Sun, Nov 29 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Production outage Nov 28 — proposed provisional credit (Meridian)

Team — forwarding Sara's note. Summary: 45m P99 spike, downstream SLA miss for Meridian. They want formal remedy language for procurement.

My recommendation (provisional):
- One-time usage credit equal to 14 days of their 30-day average spend (rounded to nearest $25).
- Two-week complimentary Sandbox extension for integration validation.
- Offer a joint RCA and a remediation ticket with priority engineering support (no-cost).

Please advise if finance/legal need to adjust wording or if we should route through Sales Ops for an approval code. I can also escalate to CS if you prefer.

Attaching the incident summary we pulled and a draft credit agreement.

Attachments: rfc-20261128-incident-summary.pdf, provisional-credit-agreement-draft.pdf

—Laura

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, Nov 30 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production outage Nov 28 — proposed provisional credit (Meridian)

Thanks Laura — I agree with the approach. A few notes from GTM/finance side:
- Approve the 14-day credit, but let's cap at $40k for this one-time comp to limit exposure. Meridian is on a tier that makes the cap reasonable.
- Sandbox extension OK.
- We should include a short acceptance clause in the credit agreement that requires Meridian to acknowledge the credit and the joint RCA delivery timeline (60 days).

Markus — can legal do a quick look at the draft clause around "no admission of liability" and the acceptance ACK? If yes, I'll greenlight and tell Laura to send the formal doc.

—Rishi

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, Nov 30 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production outage Nov 28 — proposed provisional credit (Meridian)

Rishi/Laura — reviewed. Legal is OK with the draft with two small edits:
1) Add an explicit statement that the credit is the "sole and exclusive remedy" for this incident.
2) Limit the credit validity to be applied within 90 days of issue (procurement teams often delay).

I recommend we prepare the final PDF, include the acceptance checkbox language, and route to Sara for signature. Finance should prepare the credit memo once Sara acknowledges.

Markus
General Counsel (acting)
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@meridianhealth.com>, ops@meridianhealth.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, Nov 30 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production outage Nov 28 — request for compensation

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the patience while we pulled this together. Per our review and leadership approval, Redwood will issue the following for the Nov 28 incident:

1) One-time usage credit equal to two weeks of Meridian's trailing 30-day average consumption, capped at $40,000.
2) A complimentary two-week Sandbox extension for your integration/testing team.
3) Priority engineering assistance to review the joint RCA; we will deliver the RCA within 60 days and schedule a postmortem call at your convenience.

I have attached the final credit agreement (PDF) with the acceptance checkbox and the "sole and exclusive remedy" language Mark suggested. If Meridian confirms acceptance (signed ACK or email confirmation), Finance will issue the credit memo and apply it to your next invoice. The credit must be applied within 90 days of issuance.

Attachments: provisional-credit-agreement-final.pdf

Please let me know if you'd like us to route to your procurement contact directly for signature. We appreciate the partnership and want to make this right.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
